title: dev.qory.session.turn_failed
description: A turn ended on an error from the model's API rather than on a response.

error.description: The error kind, in the runtime's words: rate_limit, overloaded, authentication_failed.

agent_id.description: The subagent this happened in, when it did not happen in the main conversation.

agent_type.description: The subagent's type, or the agent the session was started as.
